text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A-Are we really heading there?! To that 
super famous French restaurant?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not to your liking? I'll make a 
reservation at another restaurant, then.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"No, that's definitely not what I meant! 
It's just, well..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...What if I mess up my table manners at 
the restaurant...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
? What's with you all of a sudden? Isn't 
going for broke your whole deal?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Still, King-san is going to be joining us 
this time, right? What if I make a 
mistake... oh no, oh no.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll take that opportunity. Over a 
meal, I shall drill proper manners into 
you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So rest easy, and enjoy a birthday 
celebrated by a first-rate lady. Happy 
birthday, Kawakami-san.
